//counts: Measured 2026-10-10 after routing the scribe into SOAP: 2185/1443/735/7 with NO database, and 2185/2180/0/5 against a local PostgreSQL 17.10. +3 over the consent-gate figures, all three database-free, so the SKIPPED ceiling did not move. Client 383. THE RULE DID NOT CHANGE; IT MOVED TO THE RIGHT PLACE. The scribe used to draft the Subjective and nothing else, on the rule that a model drafting an assessment is a model making a clinical decision. That rule stands. What was wrong is WHERE it sat: when a pharmacist says out loud "chest is clear, looks viral, honey and fluids, come back in five days", the assessment and the plan were MADE BY A PERSON, and writing them into the right boxes is transcription. Refusing was not safety, it was making a pharmacist retype a decision they had already spoken. So the line moved from WHICH SECTION to WHOSE WORDS: the patient’s voice drafts Subjective and nothing else, the pharmacist’s drafts Objective, Assessment and Plan, and a voice that said nothing drafts nothing. The structured records (problems, interventions, referral, prescription, care-program, summary) stay forbidden, and now for a sharper reason: they are not prose but records with their own validation and their own audit trail. ONE model call with both halves labelled, because the owner asked for swift and this deployment’s model reasons for seconds - but the labelling is a HINT and each section is then validated against the words of the person who owns it, so a model that files the pharmacist’s advice as the patient’s report is caught rather than trusted. A NEW REFUSAL, hardenedACertainty: an assessment that drops a hedge the pharmacist used. "I think it MIGHT be viral" filed as "Viral upper respiratory infection" has turned a working impression into a diagnosis and the next reader cannot tell. Asked only of the Assessment, because that is the section where certainty IS the clinical content. WITHINTRANSCRIPT BECAME A RATIO, and this is a LOOSENING named as one. The first live run refused the Subjective as longer_than_transcript at 462 characters from 444 of speech - FOUR PER CENT over, on the normal case, for the most important section. Measured: subjective 1.04, objective 0.21, assessment 0.24, plan 0.44, because the Subjective covers ALL of a patient’s speech while the others cover part of the pharmacist’s. Capped at 1.5 now. It still catches a model answering a short recording with paragraphs; it never caught a fabricated symptom that fits inside the budget, at any threshold, because that is SHORTER - which needs entity-level grounding and has its own task. Six mutations run against the new safety logic and all six turned the right test red. TWO EXISTING INVARIANTS WERE AMENDED WITH THE PRODUCT, NOT RELAXED. scribeContract’s pinned SCRIBABLE === [subjective]; it now pins the stronger claim that every section is drafted from the voice that owns it AND that a forbidden section has no owning voice at all. consultationLayout’s microphone invariant pinned an early return the mode machine replaced; it now pins REACHABILITY - the microphone is opened in exactly one place, that place renders only under mode ready, and ready is reachable only via a consented note or the server’s own acceptance of consent. Measured again 2026-10-11 after adding counter patient creation: 2192/1450/735/7 with NO database and 2192/2187/0/5 with one. +7, all database-free, so the skipped ceiling did not move. The feature is an INSERT NOBODY WROTE: the route calls customerIdentity.resolveCustomer, the existing upsert that is atomic by constraint, rather than inserting into customers itself - because identity_key is unique per pharmacy and a hand-written INSERT would have worked today and produced a DUPLICATE the first time that person texted. Proven against a real database: 0803 999 1122 typed at the counter creates (201); +2348039991122 returns the SAME id with created:false (200); and the same number arriving over WhatsApp resolves to that same row, leaving ONE row for the identity, with the pharmacist's full_name surviving while display_name becomes what WhatsApp calls them (the 0020 split). A PHONE NUMBER IS REQUIRED and that is a schema fact: wa_jid is NOT NULL (0016) and identity_key is NOT NULL (0019). A walk-in with NO phone is therefore not supported, and supporting one means making wa_jid nullable, which is a change to the live identity path and belongs in its own commit. wa_jid is synthesised as <number>@s.whatsapp.net and overwritten with the real one on first message; nothing can send to it meanwhile because messageInput's outreach gate refuses a patient who has not written first. 8 mutations run and the EIGHTH WAS MISSED, which taught something: deleting the required-phone check still refuses an empty box, falling through to the parser and saying "that does not look like a phone number" - safe, and wrong for the person, because an empty field is not a malformed one. The test now asserts the MESSAGE and the mutation then failed.

//lastChange: SHELL_PLAN.md phase 5, the Website panel (2026-10-11): the brand accent comes off call-to-action buttons. THE PANEL COULD NOT BE REVIEWED AT ALL UNTIL THE API WAS RESTARTED. /api/website is mounted behind WEBSITE_BUILDER_ENABLED, unset in local development, so every call fell through to the catch-all 404 and the panel showed a red "Not found - Your website details could not be loaded". That looked exactly like the Catalogue defect and WAS NOT ONE: it was the feature switched off. Recorded because the first reading of that screen was wrong and only a restart settled it. With the builder mounted, GET /api/website answers {site: null} with a 200, exactly as its own comment says it must. WHAT IS RIGHT: the panel has the best empty state in the app - "Create your pharmacy website", a sentence saying the pharmacy name, address, hours and WhatsApp number are filled in from details they already have and that the design can change later without losing them, and three template cards each listing the sections that template produces. It is the thing the Catalogue was missing, already built. THE DEFECT: NINE call-to-action buttons were filled with the brand accent, against design.md’s CTA voice and against the owner’s own recorded answer - asked directly whether to take the Rhazes reference’s deep-green primary button they chose "layout yes, colour no", and design.md says why: "Primary: near-black fill (bg-slate-900)... Deliberately not emerald: keeping the accent off buttons is what lets it keep meaning healthy in a status pill two inches away." THE COLLISION WAS NOT HYPOTHETICAL: WebsiteHeader renders a bg-teal-50 text-teal-800 pill reading "Live" in the SAME header as a bg-teal-700 Publish button. Seven of the nine are in the website module, which was the one part of the app that never took the desk’s CTA voice; two are not (Requests’ "Send suggestion", and a primaryButton constant shared by the Templates tab and a Settings panel), and fixing seven while leaving two would have left the rule untestable, so all nine moved - one behaviour rather than a wider scope. teal-600 AND LIGHTER WERE DELIBERATELY LEFT ALONE, and that is the point rather than an exemption: the tick inside a chosen service, the open-state ring on an info toggle, the "Live" pill, the assistant’s message bubble and the sidebar’s emerald R tile (design.md specifies that tile explicitly) are identity and status, which is what the accent is FOR. Only the solid teal-700 CTA weight is forbidden. A TEST ASSERTS BOTH DIRECTIONS, because a fix that went too far would be the same mistake inverted: no CTA carries the accent, AND the "Live" pill still does. Five mutations, five of the right tests red, including the two that take the colour OFF the status pill. A NINTH WAS NEARLY MISSED: the first sweep searched for hover:bg-teal-800 and found eight; Requests’ "Send suggestion" has no hover class at all and only appeared when the search was widened to the resting fill. NOTED AND NOT CHANGED: the website module’s buttons are 14px/600 where design.md says 13px/500 (radius already matches, and type is a separate behaviour from colour); "Saved." confirmations are text-teal-700 TEXT, which is the accent meaning healthy and is allowed; the create screen’s own h2 renders larger than the shell h1, inverting the hierarchy; Billing and Setup internals are still unexamined. Client 378 -> 383.
